Diagnosis Comments:
Immunohistochemical studies were necessary to evaluate this case and establish
the correct diagnosis, and were performed and
evaluated on block B2. GFAP and IDH1 show focal positive staining in tumor
cells, and Ki-67 stain demonstrates a low labeling
index, estimated to be less than 4%. All of these findings are consistent
with a diagnosis of oligodendroglioma, WHO grade II.
